simp [h₁, h₂] at *
rw [add_right_inj, sub_right_inj]
let x_add_y := h₁
let x_sub_y := h₂
have x_eq : x = (x_add_y + x_sub_y) / 2 := by rw [add_right_inj, sub_right_inj]
have y_eq : y = (x_add_y - x_sub_y) / 2 := by rw [add_right_inj, sub_right_inj]
simp [x_eq, y_eq] at *
rw [x_eq, y_eq]
simp [mul]
